full_prompt_en: A square rotoscoped animation image contains a wide monochrome close-up between thick black bars at the top and bottom. The face of a bespectacled man is cropped so tightly that the two eyes, upper nose, and part of the cheek fill the visible strip. His gaze comes directly outward. Dark hair descends in broken strands over the brows, with sharp white streaks marking where it catches light. The eye on the image left sits in dense shadow behind a round lens; faint crosshatched lines reveal the eyelids and socket within the dark mass. The eye on the right receives striking white light, and the thin curved rim of the glasses crosses the cheek toward the outer edge. A bright triangular area runs down the side of the nose, separating the lit eye from the nearly black lower left half of the face. The background at the far right is a flat medium gray, interrupted only by a dark soft-edged shape near the border. Sketchy directional marks and simplified gray planes give the portrait the feel of filmed movement translated into drawing rather than a smooth photograph. The upper and lower black bars compress the image into a suspenseful horizontal glance. Fine light lines around the eyes, bridge, and hair sharpen the focus while broad matte areas remain quiet. Light strikes from the image right, leaving one eye luminous and the other still readable inside thick shade. The overall composition uses extreme crop, split lighting, and animated line texture to turn a direct gaze into a tense monochrome moment.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形转描动画画面在上下厚黑边之间容纳一条宽幅单色近景。戴眼镜男子的脸裁切得极紧，双眼、鼻梁上段和部分脸颊填满可见横带。他直视画外。深发以断续发丝垂到眉上，受光处由锐利白线标出。画面左侧的眼睛位于圆镜片后的浓影中，隐约交叉排线仍揭示眼睑和眼窝。右侧眼睛接住醒目的白光，细弧形镜框越过面颊通向外边缘。一片明亮三角区域沿鼻侧向下，将受光眼睛与脸部近黑的左下半边分开。最右处背景是平坦中灰，仅在边缘附近有一个柔边暗形。草图般定向笔痕与简化灰色平面使肖像像把拍摄运动转换成绘画，而不是平滑照片。上下黑边把画面压成带悬念的水平一瞥。眼、鼻梁和头发周围的细亮线使焦点清楚，宽阔哑光区域保持安静。光从画面右侧打来，让一只眼明亮，另一只眼在厚影中仍可辨认。整体构图以极近裁切、分割光线和动画线条肌理，把直接凝视变为紧张的单色瞬间。
style_prompt_en: The image has a rotoscoped animation finish in which photographic proportions are translated into hard gray planes, fine directional marks, and isolated white strokes. Large matte black masses meet pale, almost cut-paper highlights, while midgray preserves volume between them. Edges alternate between sharply inked arcs and broken sketch lines, giving still forms the trace of motion. A narrow illuminated region does most of the modeling; the opposite side holds faint detail inside shadow rather than disappearing entirely. Thick dark bands compress the active image into a horizontal passage. The overall effect is graphic, grainy, and suspenseful, balancing observed structure with visible drawing decisions.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有转描动画完成感，摄影式比例被转译成硬朗灰色平面、细定向笔痕和孤立白线。大块哑黑与近乎剪纸般的浅亮部相接，中灰则在两者之间保留体积。边缘在锐利墨线弧形与断续草图线间交替，使静止形体仍带运动痕迹。狭窄受光区域承担大部分塑造，对侧在阴影中保留淡淡细节，而非彻底消失。厚深色带把主要画面压成水平通道。整体效果图形化、带颗粒且有悬念，在观察到的结构和可见绘画取舍之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A monochrome rotoscoped extreme close-up of a bespectacled man's eyes
theme_zh: 戴眼镜男子双眼的单色转描动画极近特写
name: Rotoscope animation
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
